purpose: This document explains the purpose of Reject Booking Request function.
features: The “Reject Request” option in DCSA Booking Activity (UC4: Reject Booking Request) allows the agency user to manually select and reject a booking request received from the shipper.

The agency user can reject the request only if a booking has not yet been generated against it. If a booking has already been generated, rejection is not allowed. The reason for rejection is mandatory.
Preconditions
•	The booking request must be in SUBMITTED status.
•	A booking must not already be generated against the request.
Once the booking request is rejected by the user, the booking request is in state REJECTED.
Flow
•	The Carrier decides to reject the booking request and updates its state to REJECTED.
•	Call HQ’s Track & Trace event log procedure with the relevant parameters.
•	The Carrier sends a notification to the relevant registered counterparts with the Carrier Booking request reference, the state of the booking and the reason for rejection.
There is no need to trigger any other notifications at this time.
When the agency user rejects a DCSA booking request, the system calls the HQ Track & Trace event log procedure to record the rejection event.
Procedure Name: WEBEDI.DCSA_SHPMT_EVENT_LINKAGE.SHPMT_EVENT_DETAILS_INSERT@HQ_LINK
Key Parameter Values
•	P_DATA_SOURCE = DCSA, P_DATA_TYPE = OUT, P_DOC_TYPE = BK
•	P_DOC_NUMBER / P_DOC_ID = Carrier booking request number (T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_DOC_NUMBER)
•	P_DOC_VERSION = T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_DOC_VERSION
•	P_CONTRACT_REF = Trade ID (Case ID) if available (T_LT_DCSA_EBK_HEADER.DBH_TRADE_ID)
•	P_CURRENT_EVENT = REJECTED, P_DOCUMENT_STATUS = REJECTED
•	P_EVENT_TYPE_CODE = REJE, P_DOC_TYPE_CODE = CBR
•	P_EVENT_DATE / P_EVENT_CREATED_DATE = SYSDATE
•	P_REF_DETAILS = Type CBR, Value: Carrier booking request number
•	P_FEEDBACK_DETAILS = Rejection reason (T_LT_DCSA_EBK_NOTES.DEN_NOTES)
•	P_NFT_TO = APC
The procedure returns P_EVENT_KEY, P_PROCESS_RESULT and P_PROCESS_DESC.

events.description: Opens the "Reject Request" pop-up for the selected booking request.
events.triggered_when: User clicks "Reject Request" in the row's ☰ menu in the DCSA Activity grid.
events.remarks: "Do you want to reject this booking request (<DCSA Request ID>)?"

events.description: Blocks the rejection if the request is not in SUBMITTED status or a booking is already generated against it.
events.triggered_when: User clicks "Reject Request" and a precondition is not met.

events.description: Checks that Reason for Rejection is entered (mandatory), updates the request to REJECTED, saves the reason (T_LT_DCSA_EBK_NOTES) and calls the Track & Trace Event Log.
events.triggered_when: User enters the reason and clicks Yes.

events.description: Calls WEBEDI.DCSA_SHPMT_EVENT_LINKAGE.SHPMT_EVENT_DETAILS_INSERT@HQ_LINK to log the rejection event (P_CURRENT_EVENT = REJECTED, P_EVENT_TYPE_CODE = REJE).
